scripts.install: npm --prefix examtrace/backend install && npm --prefix examtrace/frontend install && npm --prefix exam-observer-lab install && python3 -m venv exam_incident_ai/.venv && . exam_incident_ai/.venv/bin/activate && pip install -r exam_incident_ai/requirements.txt
scripts.dev: concurrently -n examtrace,monitor -c cyan,magenta "CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=true npm --prefix examtrace run dev" "npm --prefix exam-observer-lab start"
scripts.start: concurrently -n examtrace,monitor -c cyan,magenta "CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING=true npm --prefix examtrace run dev" "npm --prefix exam-observer-lab start"
scripts.ai-train: cd exam_incident_ai && python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt && python generate_data.py && python train.py
